candidate_universe: Strike leads from actual ordinary AAPL OPRA identities in retained history/current discovery; reconstructed expiry RICs are probes only. Historical observations, not construction or current chain, determine signal-time membership. Bounds 95%-120% of prior-session stock price; no assumed strike grid or completeness claim. Existing long-call discovery has survivor bias; earlier short expiries retain their observed subset.

plan.scope: Strike leads from actual ordinary AAPL OPRA identities in retained history/current discovery; reconstructed expiry RICs are probes only. plan.valuation_policy: Daily BBO first. For missing daily BBO only, a complete same-event quote in the final 60 seconds of the actual regular session may supply a valuation-only midpoint. Never previous-session/earlier-bar fill-forward, trade/theoretical-price substitution, or null-to-zero conversion.

quote_basis: Real same-date daily closing BID/ASK; MID_PRICE cross-check; exact simultaneous quote times unknown.
quote_policy_revision: Acquisition initially isolated events for valuation. The same bounded real BBO is now consumed by closing execution too, fixing an artificial daily-only terminal rejection. Midpoint/quoted-side formulas, timestamps, positive-bid entry gate, signal choices and all strategy parameters are unchanged.

quote_recheck_summary.scope: All missing daily BBO observations in the candidate panel, NOT held-account NAV gaps.

standard_assumption_policy: source-supported standard AAPL contract assumption; not per-contract vendor historical verification
valuation_policy: Daily BBO first; when a daily leg is absent, use the LAST quote event in the final 60 seconds of the actual regular session only if its complete BBO, source timestamp and event timestamp pass validation. The same quote supports daily marking and the unchanged midpoint/quoted-side closing-fill formulas. Never treat it as an observed fill or relabel its timestamp as the exact close. No previous bar, forward fill, theoretical/trade substitution or null-to-zero conversion. Signal selection still uses the original prior-session data.

No date is chosen from subsequent strategy returns.
